content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CCI Part-time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Part-time Medical Consultant in CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Part-time Medical Consultant post in the Cement Corporation of India (CCI) Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position offering a great opportunity for medical professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for CCI Part-time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CCI Part-time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 is "Walk-in". Eligible candidates need to attend an interview directly at the specified venue and date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for CCI Part-time Medical Consultant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Part-time Medical Consultant post at CCI is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report well in advance with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Part-time Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Part-time Medical Consultant post in CCI is 65 years. There are no specific minimum age criteria mentioned for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Part-time Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/MD Degree from an MCI/NMC recognized institution with permanent registration. A minimum of one year of post-qualification experience is also required for this role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Part-time Medical Consultant position at CCI?
faq.answer: The selected Part-time Medical Consultant will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month. This is a competitive remuneration package for a contractual medical consultant role.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CCI Part-time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CCI Part-time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Part-time Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-time Medical Consultant post includes a Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, and a Medical Examination. Candidates must clear all stages to be considered for the position.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh, with pincode 173029. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue address.
